data.name: Makvana
data.gender_notes: Makvana is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Makvana is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Mak' meaning god and 'Vana' meaning abode or forest. This name signifies the dwelling place of the divine. The name Makvana carries the meaning “God's Abode” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Makvana usually hope their child will grow to embody god's abode and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes the presence of the divine.
data.etymology: Makvana belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Abode.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Makvana total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
